jobDescription: A scheduling-software company used by clinics and salons runs several hundred product experiments a year across web and mobile. The data scientist in the growth team designs and analyses experiments, sets the direction for the experimentation platform roadmap, builds conversion models, maintains the metric definitions in the semantic layer and helps product managers read experiment results correctly. The roadmap is reviewed each January by the product leadership group, which expects the trade-offs between speed, statistical rigour and engineering cost to be laid out explicitly.
requirements: Designs and analyses product experiments with power calculations agreed in advance.
Sets the direction for the experimentation platform roadmap and presents its trade-offs to product leadership.
Builds conversion models in Python or R.
Maintains metric definitions in the semantic layer.
Coaches product managers on interpreting experiment results.

evidence.text: Data scientist at Pellucid Forms (online forms software), January 2021 to present, designing and analysing pricing-page and onboarding experiments with power calculations agreed with the product manager before launch.
Built the trial-to-paid conversion model in Python (logistic regression on usage features), refreshed monthly for the sales team's lead scoring.
Maintained 35 metric definitions in the semantic layer, including activation, weekly active teams and net revenue retention, with a change log for each edit.
Introduced CUPED variance reduction into the experiment analysis notebooks after comparing it with the unadjusted estimates on 12 past tests.
Answered product managers' questions on experiment readouts at a weekly drop-in session held in the growth team's channel, and kept a running page of the questions that came up most often.

Work sample: an experiment readout for the onboarding checklist test, with the pre-registered hypothesis, the power calculation, the CUPED-adjusted lift and confidence interval, and the decision recorded by the product manager.

Reference check summary: the former director of data science confirmed in writing that the candidate wrote the 2024 experimentation roadmap, which set out the move to sequential testing and a shared metric layer, and presented its trade-offs to the product leadership group in January 2024.
Recruiter logistics note: the candidate can take the final interview in the week of 18 November and has asked for the case review to be scheduled in the morning.
